capabilities: Draw the vault repository's Git commit graph with branch lanes and ref capsules
Expand inline commit details with author, message, and changed files
Open a commit's file diff in a new editor tab
Watch the .git directory and refresh the graph automatically
Filter and search commits by ref, author, hash, or description
extras: Strictly read-only: it never commits, checks out, fetches, pushes, or pulls, and makes no network requests. Requires Obsidian 1.7.2+ on desktop and documents installation via coding agents (AGENTS.md). Lists its own limitations, including an O(n^2) layout risk on extreme topologies and text-only diffs.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to see the Git history of the repository containing the vault as a visual commit graph with diffs.

relations.evidence: draws its history the way VS Code's Source Control graph does

summary: Desktop-only viewer that renders the vault repository's Git history as an interactive commit graph with inline commit details and file diffs in a side pane.
